narr: Very heavy rain fell across portions of east central Illinois on August 5th which resulted in areas of flash flooding. The highest storm total rainfall amounts included 6.50 inches in Paxton and two miles west northwest of Loda; 6.34 inches two miles east of Claytonville; 6.28 inches four miles east northeast of Buckley; 6.00 inches one mile east of Loda; 5.97 inches in Buckley; 5.79 inches one mile west of Woodworth; 5.34 inches two miles east southeast of Buckley; 4.26 inches three miles east northeast of Milford; 4.14 inches near Chatsworth and 4.10 inches near Clifton.
ev: A viaduct along Route 1 north of Milford was closed and impassible due to flooding.

Several portions of Route 9 were closed east of Paxton due to flooding. Winter Street was blockaded. A photo shared on social media showed a rain gauge near Paxton with a storm total of 6.50 inches of rain.
lsr: Several portions of State Route 9 closed east of Paxton. Winter Street blockaded. Call to the PD placed at 220, but road closure time estimated.
Viaduct along State Route 1 north of Milford flooded with SR 1 closed and impassable at this time. Call to PD made at 230 PM.
